text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were at the following levels, with week-ago and year-ago levels, industry sources said.
All figures in thousands of tonnes,
Motor gasoline stocks rose despite outgoing transatlantic shipments and barge departures as barge and cargo arrivals rose.
Naphtha inventories were down slightly as there were almost no incoming cargoes or barges.
Gas oil stocks rose, although there was very quick throughput of cargoes from the former Soviet Union (FSU) and the United States. A further 300,000 tonnes are due to arrive.
Fuel oil inventories dipped with little incoming material but with some losses to the bunker market and Germany.
Jet fuel stocks were down after the aviation sector took product. - Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5004
